This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, umzwa, ngaphambili, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 練 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

z: 緹 umnkantsha womgogodla, umzwa, ngaphambili, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Do not correct a grieving person into cheer. Bring food. Take the lower seat. Let the name of the absent be said. The name is how the absent remain in the family.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, umzwa, ngaphambili, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 緹 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

z: 緻 umnkantsha womgogodla, umzwa, ngaphambili, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Open the curtain before you decide what the day is. Let the house see you do it. The gesture is small, and it is the whole teaching.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, umzwa, ngaphambili, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 緻 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Make one plan for tomorrow small enough that both of you can keep it.

z: 縁 umnkantsha womgogodla, umzwa, ngaphambili, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Do one undeserved kindness to the person you are keeping score against. Do not mention the score. The mention would turn the kindness back into a move.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, umzwa, ngaphambili, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縁 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Leave one cut unanswered today. Do not announce the leaving.

z: 縄 umnkantsha womgogodla, umzwa, ngaphambili, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
The counsel that lasted did not flatter rage. It asked the strong to become a wall for the weak. That is the ethic of a parent and of an elder: your size is a shelter, or it is a threat.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, umzwa, ngaphambili, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縄 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

z: 縅 umnkantsha womgogodla, umzwa, ngaphambili, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The old wisdom is severe on the high seat. It is not severe on the upright spine. Stand up. Then let the others stand. A house of one standing person is a court, not a family.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, umzwa, ngaphambili, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縅 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Admit one small wrong without a speech about your intentions. Stop when the admission is complete.

z: 縈 umnkantsha womgogodla, umzwa, ngaphambili, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
A child who is envied by a parent carries a weight no child can name. Admiration from above is a kind of safety. It says, your becoming does not threaten my place.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, umzwa, ngaphambili, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縈 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Clap, or thank, before you comment. Let the first sound from you be glad.

z: 縉 umnkantsha womgogodla, umzwa, ngaphambili, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
A child learns courage from a body that does not abandon the feeling. Sit until the breath slows. Explanation can wait. Presence cannot.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, umzwa, ngaphambili, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縉 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Tell the truth you have been saving, and remain in the room after it is told.

z: 縊 umnkantsha womgogodla, umzwa, ngaphambili, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Children do not need every desire answered. They need to see a hand open. The open hand is their picture of tomorrow, and tomorrow is either a threat or a table.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, umzwa, ngaphambili, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縊 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Put one thing you were keeping back into the middle of the table.

z: 縋 umnkantsha womgogodla, umzwa, ngaphambili, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
A child believes the sentence more than the apology that follows it. Speak as if the sentence will live in them, because it will. This is not fear. It is care.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, umzwa, ngaphambili, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縋 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

z: 縐 umnkantsha womgogodla, umzwa, ngaphambili, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu
line:
The ordinary work, the meal, the repaired hinge, the repeated story, is the curriculum of a family. Thank the labor, not the performance of being easy to live with.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, umzwa, ngaphambili, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縐 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Remove the sneer from a sentence and speak it again. Notice how much of it was only the sneer.

z: 縑 umnkantsha womgogodla, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
A child does not need a conversation performed. A child needs a person who can be found. Being findable is the practice. The words can come later, or not.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縑 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Sit with a person who is not ready to speak. Let ten minutes pass without fixing them.

z: 縒 umnkantsha womgogodla, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Forgiveness does not require the betrayed to be foolish. It requires them to decide whether the person is still a member. Membership is a practice after it has been a wound.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縒 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Eat together once without retelling the wound. Let the meal be only a meal.

z: 縕 umnkantsha womgogodla, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
A marriage that has lost a child, or a parent, or a future, needs presence more than explanation. Explanation is a way of leaving. Sitting is a way of staying.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縕 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Answer the ordinary request of a grieving child. Do not make them perform a sadness you recognize.

z: 縗 umnkantsha womgogodla, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
A marriage in despair does not need a speech about gratitude. It needs one true plan for tomorrow that both people can bear. Make the plan small enough to be kept.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縗 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Decline the word forever. Keep the true sentence about the pain, and stop before the lie.

z: 縛 umnkantsha womgogodla, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
In a marriage, revenge is often petty and therefore easy to excuse. The small cut, repeated, is how love is replaced by a contest. Mercy is leaving one cut unanswered.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縛 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Tell the truth of the wrong once, to the person, and then do not serve it at breakfast.

z: 縝 umnkantsha womgogodla, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Accountability begins when you can say, the heat was mine. Wisdom begins when you can say, it had a better door. Compassion begins when the person you nearly burned is still in the room, and you stay.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縝 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Teach the strong child to stand in front of the smaller one. That is anger, turned, and it can be learned young.

z: 縞 umnkantsha womgogodla, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Self-reflection is the moment you notice you needed to win. Accountability is saying so before you are forced. The turn from pride to dignity is mostly this small honesty.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, phezulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縞 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Praise a person in the house for a quality you do not share. Do not add a correction.

z: 縟 umnkantsha womgogodla, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Siblings are assigned the same story and different gifts. Envy calls this injustice. Admiration calls it a house with more than one lamp. Both lamps belong on the table.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縟 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: When a sibling is praised, add one true sentence of your own. Do not balance it with your own news.

z: 縠 umnkantsha womgogodla, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Many houses, under many names, give the same command: do not be ruled by dread, and do not despise the person who is. The strong are asked to stay, not to sneer.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縠 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Name the person you are afraid of losing, and spend the next hour near them without a speech.

z: 縡 umnkantsha womgogodla, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Hospitality is the oldest sociology of the lasting house. The stranger eats first. The family that cannot do this for a guest will eventually fail to do it for itself.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縡 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Give a thing away that you still like. Do not wait until you are tired of it.

z: 縢 umnkantsha womgogodla, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Siblings remember the name they were called on the worst day. Do not give them that name. Give them the name of the good you have actually seen them do.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縢 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Tell one story tonight in which a person in this house is repaired, not mocked.

z: 縣 umnkantsha womgogodla, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Children who are met with contempt learn to hide the clumsy part, which is most of them. Appreciation gives that part a chair.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縣 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Ask to be shown a skill you had decided was beneath you. Watch the whole way through.

z: 縦 umnkantsha womgogodla, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
The old practice of sitting with the sick, of keeping watch, of not filling the air, is this turn. Do not rush to be useful. Be there.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縦 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

z: 縧 umnkantsha womgogodla, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The wisdom shared by many houses is hard: do not let the sun go down on a break you are willing to heal, and do not call it healing if you are only waiting to retell it.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縧 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

z: 縨 umnkantsha womgogodla, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Children grieve in strange hours and then ask for ordinary things. Both are grief. Answer the ordinary thing. Do not make them perform a sadness you can recognize.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縨 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

z: 縫 umnkantsha womgogodla, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
A child who sees an adult look again, after a bad day, learns that a bad day is not a verdict. This is worth more than any optimism you could announce.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縫 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Open the curtain before you decide what the day is. Let the house see you do it.

z: 縬 umnkantsha womgogodla, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Children are the usual casualties of a score kept between adults. They did not agree to carry it. Mercy toward the person you resent is also protection of the child.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縬 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Do one undeserved kindness where you are keeping score. Do not mention the score.

z: 縮 umnkantsha womgogodla, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Siblings fight because they share a roof and a hunger. The fight is not the failure. The failure is when the stronger one discovers a liking for the smaller one's fear. Protection refuses that discovery.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縮 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: When the heat rises, name who you are actually keeping safe. Put your body between the danger and the child. Do not spend the heat on the child.

z: 縱 umnkantsha womgogodla, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Brothers and sisters are the first public. What you do to be admired at home becomes the way they will treat their own children. Give them a dignity they can copy.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縱 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Once, take the lower seat on purpose. Let someone in the house finish a story you could have told better.

z: 縲 umnkantsha womgogodla, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The teachings that endured all warn the eye. They also bless the eye that rejoices. Rejoicing is not a mood. It is a decision made again each time the other person shines.

This is the work of an ordinary evening, which is where a family is actually made. What you are seeing is umnkantsha womgogodla, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 縲 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Clap, or thank, before you comment. Let the first sound from you be glad.
